name: evoto
description: eVoto — sistema de votação electrónica seguro (React + Vite + Node.js + Express)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm exec -w client -- tsc -b
